user_profile.settings.avatarModerationAp: The api_secret of the Sightengine account. Stored encrypted.
The api_user of the Sightengine account.
user_profile.settings.avatarModerationPr: Checks a new avatar or header image with the provider and refuses it when flagged. If the provider cannot be reached the image is allowed.
user_profile.settings.avatarModerationTh: A score from 0.01 to 1 at or above which an image is refused. Lower refuses more. Anything else reads as 0.6.
user_profile.settings.profileCustomField: Comma-separated custom profile field names a member may save. A field outside the list is refused. Empty = any field.
user_profile.settings.reservedDisplayNam: Comma-separated names nobody in this organization may take as a display name, on top of the built-in ones (admin, support, owner, ...). Matched without case.
user_profile.settings.subtitle: Reserved display names, allowed custom fields and image moderation for member profiles
user_profile.settings.title: Profile Settings
